org_queries.purpose: List all Agent% classes, namespace, sharing mode, and count Storefront__c SOQL per body (tests D1 claim of 20 classes / 7+2 querying classes)
org_queries.command_summary: Tooling SELECT Id, Name, NamespacePrefix, LengthWithoutComments, Body FROM ApexClass WHERE Name LIKE 'Agent%'; local regex

org_queries.purpose: Confirm no existing shared storefront selector/service/util class
org_queries.command_summary: Tooling SELECT Name, NamespacePrefix FROM ApexClass ORDER BY Name

org_queries.purpose: Find other unmanaged classes referencing Storefront__c or Agent*Actions classes (siblings, callers)
org_queries.command_summary: Tooling SELECT Name, Body FROM ApexClass WHERE NamespacePrefix = null; local search

org_queries.purpose: Existing test coverage of Agent*Actions classes
org_queries.command_summary: Tooling SELECT ApexClassOrTrigger.Name, NumLinesCovered, NumLinesUncovered FROM ApexCodeCoverageAggregate WHERE ApexClassOrTrigger.Name LIKE 'Agent%'

org_queries.purpose: Dependencies on the 9 classes to be updated
org_queries.command_summary: Tooling MetadataComponentDependency WHERE RefMetadataComponentId IN (9 class Ids)

org_queries.purpose: Agent actions invoking the classes (signature must not change)
org_queries.command_summary: Tooling SELECT DeveloperName, InvocationTarget FROM GenAiFunctionDefinition WHERE InvocationTargetType = 'apex'

org_queries.purpose: Storefront__c fields referenced by the queries exist
Required createable fields on Storefront__c for test data (T OD-3)
org_queries.command_summary: sf sobject describe --sobject Storefront__c; filter non-nillable createable non-defaulted

org_queries.purpose: Validation rules on Storefront__c affecting test inserts
org_queries.command_summary: Tooling SELECT ValidationName, Active FROM ValidationRule WHERE EntityDefinition.QualifiedApiName = 'Storefront__c'
Tooling SELECT Name FROM ApexTrigger WHERE TableEnumOrId = 'Storefront__c'
SELECT ApiName, IsActive, TriggerType FROM FlowDefinitionView WHERE TriggerObjectOrEventId = 'Storefront__c'

skill_friction: D2 was not sent: D1 already returned the class-level behavior (all nine querying classes, sharing modes) and the runner moved straight to org verification; the SKILL says 'Send D1 then D2' but gives no rule for skipping D2 when D1 over-delivers behavior for a pure-Apex refactor. This is a protocol deviation in this run, not an AskCoworker failure.

Refactor requirements (behavior-preserving code restructuring) are not addressed by design-rules.md: rules like 'every change traces to the requirement' and 'minimal design' pulled in opposite directions on whether to include the two non-duplicated list queries (AskCoworker I excluded them; runner included them to satisfy 'they all query storefronts separately'). A rule on how far a consolidation refactor should reach would help.

The two-wrong-AskCoworker-claims threshold was crossed by platform claims in R/T (inherited sharing entry-point default, sharing keywords vs CRUD/FLS, flow interview transactions) after the inventory was already built; the SKILL does not say whether earlier-kept AskCoworker facts must be retroactively re-verified (here all kept facts were already org-verified).

AskCoworker labels echoed facts as 'prior session' even though they came from the current message; the rule on echoes handled it, but it also mixed in untraceable 'prior session' facts (Data Cloud connector permission, DataStream count) that had to be dropped.
ApexCodeCoverageAggregate returning 0 covered lines for all classes is ambiguous (tests never run vs. no coverage); org-verification.md has no note on interpreting it.
spec-format.md Section 7 gives no guidance for test layout in a pure refactor (regression tests for unchanged behavior vs. new behavior tests).
